facts.claim: hel_snapshot_tree writes one pid/pgid line per process into hel_tree; hel_tree_running passes that potentially multiline value as awk -v tree="$hel_tree". hel_running invokes this after the leader group empties, and hel_stop propagates a liveness-check status other than 1, so an awk invocation error aborts stopping before cleanup.

The target macOS awk rejects a literal newline embedded in a -v assignment argument, returning an error rather than the intended membership-test status. Therefore the multiline tree argument at this invocation can fail despite valid process data.

notes: Platform behavior is supported by the fix commit report, not by executing awk. The shell functions are embedded in a Rust raw string; the locator identifies the Rust script generator. The failure occurs when the tree check is reached and the snapshot contains multiple lines, not on every stop of a process with descendants.

facts.claim: Transcript body gutters and tool/plan glyphs now read theme::glyphs(), which selects SYMBOLS independently of CURRENT (the palette); render_combined selects the configured symbol set with with_symbols on each render. Thus changing symbols can change the required rows while palette, width, mode and entries stay the same.

prepare_render_cache clears cached entries for width, mode or theme::current changes, and for changed collapse states, but does not compare the symbol set. cached_entry_lines reuses an existing row when its revision and summary fingerprint are unchanged, returning the stored rendered lines without invoking the renderer again. A symbol-only change therefore retains the old glyphs.
